exit 0
--- stdout
Remove an agent from the state database.
Useful when an agent has crashed or shutdown uncleanly and needs to be removed
from the system. By default, refuses to delete agents with active leases or
current tasks.
Usage:
liza delete agent <agent-id> [flags]
Flags:
--force force deletion even if agent has active lease or current task
-h, --help help for agent
--reason string reason for deleting the agent (default "manual deletion")
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
